---
name: nimbus-bug-fix
description: Diagnose and fix a Nimbus-Commerce bug.
---

Trace the reported failure first.

1. Reproduce or identify the root cause.
2. Inspect adjacent implementation/tests.
3. Make the smallest safe fix.
4. Add a regression test when appropriate.
5. Run relevant validation.
6. Review for unintended changes.

Do not hide failures or make unrelated refactors.
